title: SoPE: Spherical Coordinate-Based Positional Embedding for Enhancing Spatial Perception of 3D LVLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing cross-modal attention patterns via information flow visualization from point cloud tokens to textual prompts to identify attention concentration on hotspots, and evaluating 3D layout estimation and object detection performance across benchmarks (e.g., ARKitScenes, Structured3D) to measure the suppression of small objects and structural boundaries.
